title: Podcast EP380: The Focus and Goals of the UK Semiconductor Centre with Andy McLean
text:

Daniel is joined by Andy McLean, a passionate results-oriented leader with more than 35 years of semiconductor industry experience, building and leading global teams. He has a proven track record of developing products, introducing new technologies and growing revenue for customers in telecom, communications, data centers, video processing, industrial and automotive industries. Before joining the UK Semiconductor Centre as its first CEO, Andy spent his career at Analog Devices, Texas Instruments, and National Semiconductor.
The UK Semiconductor Centre is a strategic hub created to unite and promote the sector to drive scale-up and growth. Daniel explores the charter, focus and progress of this organization with Andy, who explains the overall goal is to extend the UK’s significant semiconductor capabilities to the world stage. Andy discusses some technical focus areas, including photonics, power management, AI, smart grid, and quantum computing. He also explains the organization’s broad charter, which includes promoting investment in the region, support for skills and workforce development, and international partnerships.
The organization is well-aligned with the goals of the Microelectronics UK and US conferences. The UK Semiconductor Centre participated in Microelectronics UK in September. Microelectronics US is coming up on 4–5 May 2027 in Austin, Texas, and Microelectronics UK will return to London on 29–30 September 2027.
